'''Jiyan Dar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ongree/Legends|Ongree]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and helped [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] in the [[Battle of Ilum]], a battle fought during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
